# Security Checklist: Harness Surface Inventory and Gap Taxonomy

**Purpose**: Validate that HRNS-001 requirements define telemetry/privacy, supply-chain, evidence authority, and self-improvement safety boundaries without authorizing runtime changes.
**Created**: 2026-07-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are telemetry/privacy and licensing/supply-chain evidence fields required for every external candidate row? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are unsafe evidence classes such as raw transcripts, unreviewed chat, caches, and generated outputs explicitly excluded from factual authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Are self-improvement loop closure classes required for every workflow that can generate or influence future harness behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is `unknown/non-promotable` clearly defined as a fail-closed state when approval-boundary evidence is missing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the line between reference evidence and required dependency adoption unambiguous for external candidates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Are disallowed open-ended recursive or self-modifying harness-control loops clearly excluded? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do the spec and plan consistently prohibit package installation, candidate prototyping, telemetry submission, and runtime dependency adoption in HRNS-001? [Consistency, Spec §Reviewability Notes, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK008 Do candidate recommendation values avoid language that could be interpreted as security or supply-chain approval? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK009 Are privacy, telemetry, licensing, and supply-chain postures required as row-level evidence rather than general narrative claims? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements explicit that imported or external knowledge must not be treated as executable instruction or authorization? [Coverage, PRD AC-4.10 reference in Plan §Research]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can the PR packet objectively prove HRNS-001 did not authorize dependency adoption, runtime changes, or generated-artifact changes? [Measurability, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements]
- [ ] CHK012 Are intentional deferrals required to name an owning HRNS, CAR, G56R, or roadmap entry? [Measurability, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements]
